description: Canonical JSON Schema (Draft 2020-12) for charts/lenny/values.yaml, generated from pkg/chart/values. spec: §17.6.

cluster.description: Cluster-type composition dimension (laptop, eks, gke, aks, openshift, or vanilla). §17.9.1 line 1351.

environment.description: Target environment (local, dev, or prod): drives alert thresholds, warm-pool sizes, and log verbosity (§17.6 question phase, §17.9.1).

deploymentTier.description: Static metric tier label (tier1/tier2/tier3, or empty to omit the deployment_tier relabel). §16.1.1.

devMode.description: Relaxes multi-tenant admission controls for local development. Never enable on a multi-tenant cluster. §4.9.

maintenanceMode.description: When true, the §25.6 doctor --fix auto-remediation surface skips every remediation. §25.6 line 2974.

noEnvironmentPolicy.description: Platform-wide default access policy for a session that names no environment. §10.6 / §17.6 line 365.

saTokenAudience.description: Projected SA-token audience the gateway validates on every pod→gateway request. §10.3 line 334.

spiffeTrustDomain.description: SPIFFE trust domain anchoring agent-pod and interceptor identities. Required (no default); helm templating fails when unset. §10.3 line 316.

traceSamplingRate.description: Default probabilistic tail-sampling rate the OpenTelemetry Collector applies to normal traces. §16.3 line 359.

isolationProfile.description: Isolation-profile composition dimension (baseline, sandboxed, or hypervisor): sets the default RuntimeClass for seeded runtimes. §17.9.1 line 1354.

acknowledgeApiKeyMode.description: Acknowledges the §27.9 paste-form phishing surface for authMode=apiKey outside dev mode.

allowedRuntimes.description: Comma-separated glob list of runtime IDs the playground runtime picker offers. Default is every visible runtime.

bearerTtlSeconds.description: TTL of an MCP bearer token minted by POST /v1/playground/token. The gateway bounds it to 60..3600.

devTenantId.description: Tenant bound to every dev-mode playground token; applies only when authMode is dev. §27.3.

enabled.description: Turns the §27 playground on. Off by default.

gatewayHost.description: Public gateway host the playground UI connects to over the MCP WebSocket. §27.7 connect-src CSP.

maxIdleTimeSeconds.description: §27.6 hard idle-timeout override for a playground-initiated session.

maxSessionMinutes.description: §27.6 hard cap on a playground-initiated session's duration.

oidcSessionTtlSeconds.description: Lifetime of the §27.3.1 server-side playground session record and its cookie.

sessionLabels.description: §27.2 operator-tunable label map stamped on every playground session record and audit event.
